children: Latin America energy firm's Q3 revenue fell 19% quarter-over-quarter on lower realized prices
Adjusted EBITDA dropped 37% due to lower oil prices and higher operating costs
Company completed $550 mln senior notes issuance to support growth and refinancing
Company expects full-year 2026 results to remain within market guidance
GeoPark is optimizing 4Q2026 hedge positions to offset weaker crude oil differentials
GeoPark has hedged about 22,500 bopd for 2027 at average strikes of $70/$50/$78.9 per boe
LOWER REALIZED PRICES - Wider crude oil differentials reduced realized pricing, pressuring margins
HIGHER OPERATING COSTS - Operating costs rose due to higher energy expenses, more well interventions and local currency appreciation
LOWER SALES VOLUMES - Sales volumes declined due to lack of incremental pipeline inventory sales
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GeoPark Ltd is $12.20, about 17.5% above its November 2 closing price of $10.38
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
